Because love lives in the little things.

Most relationships are not held together by anniversaries. They are held together by the text about the weather, the song sent at midnight, the photo of a bad sandwich you both still talk about.

We made Klin because those things deserve somewhere to live that is not a crowded group chat or a camera roll nobody scrolls. It is a small space for two people. It will not ask you to perform and it will not keep score.

It just keeps the little things close, so they are easy to find when you want them.

What we hold to

Two people, nobody else
A space belongs to the two of you. There is no feed, no followers and no audience.
No guilt
Streaks are off unless you turn them on. Reminders are quiet. A missed day is just a missed day.
Honest about privacy
We tell you what is protected and how, including what is not. We will not describe Klin as end-to-end encrypted unless it is.
Yours to take with you
You can export what you have saved, and you can delete your account.

Love, in all the little things.
